def straight_high(ranks: list[str]) -> str | None:
    """Return the highest rank of a straight if ranks form a straight, else None."""
    # Order of ranks from lowest to highest
    order = "23456789TJQKA"
    # Convert each rank to its index in the order string
    indices = sorted(order.index(r) for r in ranks)

    # Check for normal straight: consecutive indices
    if all(indices[i] + 1 == indices[i + 1] for i in range(4)):
        return order[indices[-1]]

    # Check for Ace-low straight (A,2,3,4,5)
    # In this case indices will be [0,1,2,3,12] (A is 12)
    if indices == [0, 1, 2, 3, 12]:
        return "5"

    return None
